What I Wanted to Say (WIWS)

Privacy policy

How this app handles data.

SupportPrivacy policyApp details ↗

Updated October 21, 2026. This page describes data handling for WIWS, currently under App Store review.

Diary storage

Diaries, English drafts, corrections, phrases and weekly reflections are stored on your device by default. If enabled, they are also stored and synced in your own iCloud Drive. iCloud processing follows Apple’s services and your settings. Nothing is stored on the developer’s servers.

AI processing

Corrections, vocabulary hints and phrases send your prepared Japanese and English through the developer’s relay on Cloudflare to cloud AI (Anthropic, with OpenAI as a fallback). Questions, transcription suggestions and the weekly reflection use the original diary and run on the device with Apple’s AI where available. They go to the cloud only when you turn on “Send the original diary to AI” (off by default). On devices without Apple Intelligence the setting is not shown; the original diary is sent to the cloud for questions and transcription, and the app says so. If you use your diary unchanged as writing material, the text sent for correction includes it. Each step shows where processing happens.

Voice (ElevenLabs)

Hearing English or phrases with ElevenLabs voices happens only after you accept the separate voice consent in the app (the same on the Free, Pro and Max plans; you can withdraw it any time in Settings). After you agree, when you play, only the English or phrase being played is sent to ElevenLabs through the developer’s relay on Cloudflare. Your original diary, Japanese summary, dates and purchase information are not sent. The relay does not store or log the text or the audio. ElevenLabs normally keeps the text and generated audio and does not state a fixed retention period; related information may remain in backups for up to 30 days and in debugging or abuse-prevention logs after history is deleted, and depending on ElevenLabs’ settings the content may be used to improve its models. Withdrawing consent or deleting audio on your device does not delete ElevenLabs’ history. Generated audio is stored only on your device, excluded from iCloud and backups, and can be deleted in Settings.

Operational data

The relay does not store or log diary or English text. Operational aggregates include task, model, plan, outcome, processing time and estimated cost, without text, IP addresses or device identifiers. External AI providers process requests under their own data terms. Your thumbs up or down on a correction is kept on the device only and is not sent in this version.

On-device only

Widgets, the bundled diary-quote data, records (days written, completion rate) and reminders are processed on the device without network access. Widgets never contain diary text and are excluded from iCloud and backups.

Purchases and abuse prevention

Apple processes purchases. The relay handles purchase verification, installation identifiers, usage counts, and the number and length of voice requests (never their text) to verify subscriptions, manage trials and quotas, and prevent abuse. The developer does not receive credit card details.

Reminders, app lock, and contact

Reminders are scheduled locally. The operating system handles Face ID and Touch ID; the developer does not receive biometric data. App lock does not protect diary files in iCloud. Support email addresses and message content are used to respond and are also processed by the email service.

Manage or delete diaries within the app, and review Apple’s settings for iCloud copies and backups. Contact support@mtk.sh with data questions. This page will be updated when practices change.
